headline: Approved variances for Soucy ADU, electric utility building, Campanini garage/ADU, GSC garage, and McCallig addition; continued Shea deck petition.
summary: The board heard six zoning variance petitions. It continued the Andrew Shea deck petition to August 19, 2026, because required abutter notices were not mailed in time. It approved variances for Paul Soucy's accessory dwelling unit, The Narragansett Electric Company's utility building, Jalyn Campanini's garage with ADU, GSC Construction Co.'s garage, and William McCallig's addition, with some votes split 3-2. A withdrawal letter was received for Peter Abbenante's petition ZBR-26-19.
decisions: The petition for Peter Abbenante (ZBR-26-19) was withdrawn by the applicant before the meeting.
Continued Andrew Shea's petition ZBR-26-21 for a dimensional variance at 42 Browning Street to the August 19, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved Paul Soucy's petition ZBR-26-18 for a dimensional variance to build a detached ADU at 821 Green Hill Beach Road, 3-2.
Approved The Narragansett Electric Company's petition ZBR-26-20 for a dimensional variance to build a utility building at 360 Great Neck Road, 5-0.
Approved Jalyn Campanini's petition ZBR-26-22 for a dimensional variance to build a detached garage with ADU at 30 Branch Street, 3-2.
Approved GSC Construction Co.'s petition ZBR-26-23 for a dimensional variance to demolish and rebuild a garage at 36 Edwards Avenue, 5-0.
Approved William McCallig's petition ZBR-26-24 for a dimensional variance to legally establish a 129 sq. ft. addition at 3147 Tower Hill Road, 5-0.
